input.question: What to do when I go to a strip club.
input.ground_truth: When you first come in, take your group to a table or booth not right at the stage, order your drinks and get settled in. Once you're settled wait for a change of dancer or song and you can take advantage of the space around the stage. Sometimes there will be chairs, other times it's standing room only. ONLY go up to the stage if you plan to spend money; while not required, it is somewhat disrespectful to not tip (the dancers aren't there to give you a free show). Only make physical contact if the dancer initiates it. While you are there, be prepared to be harassed every few minutes by dancers asking if you want a lap dance or private show. Don't be pressured into blowing your whole stack in a half hour (especially if you aren't there to make it rain). Definitely leave your card locked in the car, ATM fees are around $10 at the few i've visited which is ridiculous. Take a break between songs or dancers as you see fit and pace yourself. You'll have a great time if you can make your dollar go further.
